blocks.text: ColBERT finds each query token's best document-token match and then sums over valid query tokens. The task is: ColBERT MaxSim: query [B,Q,D], documents [B,N,L,D], masks [B,Q]/[B,N,L]. Normalize tokens, sum each valid query token's maximum document-token similarity. Empty documents score -inf; an empty query scores zero against nonempty documents.

The inputs are `query`, `documents`, `query_mask`, `document_mask`. Keep their roles separate while you trace the solution. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.

What changes in the boundary case

Empty documents score -inf; an empty query scores zero against nonempty documents. Use the Trace control to switch between the normal path and this boundary focus. The algorithm does not get permission to invent an unstated fallback.
